response.sql: WITH color_amounts AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), color_metrics AS (SELECT invoiced_amount, invoiced_amount / SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS share, AVG(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS average_per_color FROM color_amounts) SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(invoiced_amount - average_per_color) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average FROM color_metrics WHERE invoiced_amount > average_per_color

assumptions.assumption: The per-color average includes colors with invoice line items. Invoiced amount is derived_total_cost.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every color in Products in the per-color average, assigning zero to colors with no invoice line items.
